description:
This impressive five-bedroom detached family home comes to the market in excellent decorative condition and enjoys a particularly desirable position within the established Cloon Lara development, just approximately 1.5 miles from Mullingar town centre. 

The accommodation opens with a bright entrance hall finished with tiled flooring and coving. The spacious living room enjoys features laminate flooring, coving and a solid fuel stove set on a marble base. Double doors connect to the exceptionally spacious kitchen, dining and living area. This impressive open-plan space is fitted with a range of wall and floor units, marble countertops and a central island incorporating a gas hob and oven. The adjoining utility room offers excellent additional storage, plumbing for laundry appliances, a shelved hotpress and its own rear access. A separate home office with a bay window, and a generously proportioned double bedroom/games room and an upgraded guest WC.

Upstairs, a spacious landing provides access to four further double bedrooms. Two benefit from built-in wardrobes, with two also enjoying its own en-suite shower room. The principal bedroom is particularly impressive, featuring a generous walk-in wardrobe and private en-suite. A fully tiled family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.

Externally, the property is equally appealing, with a large and well-maintained garden with a gazebo and garden shed. To the front, the cobblelock driveway provides ample off-street parking.

Mullingar town centre is approximately 1.5 miles away, while the property is within the Ballina school catchment area. Shandonagh GAA grounds and Fagan's Equestrian Centre are approximately three-quarters of a mile away, with Lough Ennell approximately two miles from the property, providing easy access to a variety of sporting and recreational amenities.

Offering extensive five-bedroom accommodation, a dedicated home office, generous open-plan living space and impressive gardens in a convenient setting close to Mullingar, this is an excellent opportunity to acquire a substantial detached family home. Early viewing is highly recommended.
